summary: Frontend-only E2E of Marketplace + Cart + Checkout for Goorin B2B Ops. All specified flows verified: 12 product cards, search/collection/shape/sort/favorites/list-tile/empty state, sold-out disabled (p11), placeholder (p5), CSV template download, cart add/qty updates with 15-min reservation countdown, cart bar totals, checkout steps, contact card, saved vs new address (with validation banner, missing-field enumeration, and disabled continue), address form fields, use-for segmented control, save-address, same-billing (billing card hides), custom ship window + date requirement, PO input, summary sidebar (inc/dec/remove) with totals updating, payment step (50% Prepay / 50% Net 60, Due now = half of total), back-shipping preserves form + PO, place-order success toast, cart cleared, navigates to My Orders placeholder, cart-button navigates to Marketplace when empty and to Checkout when populated, checkout-back preserves cart. No console errors and no pageerrors observed.
critical_code_review_comments: cart.tsx useEffect resets reservedUntil when lines empties but does NOT reset the timer when a new set of items is added after full clear — currently ok because reservedUntil is null when empty and only reset once. Minor: could be race with rapid add/remove. Not blocking.
MarketplacePage.tsx line 67 uses ternary with side-effects (n.has(id) ? n.delete(id) : n.add(id)) — lint may flag no-unused-expressions; harmless.
CheckoutPage saved address is a hardcoded const module-level object; consider co-locating with user profile mock for future backend wiring.
downloadTemplate() creates an object URL but never calls URL.revokeObjectURL — minor memory leak on repeated downloads.
test_credentials: Mock auth per /app/memory/test_credentials.md — empty-field login succeeds.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Custom-styled checkboxes (co-check span) hide the real <input>, so Playwright .click() on the input reports 'outside viewport'. Use JS-based click (el.click()) or click the wrapping label. Data-testids on inputs still work for is_checked() reads. Scroll container is .page-content (not window). Cart bar is a fixed overlay — clicks routed to checkout via cart-bar-checkout. Toasts render in .toast-viewport.
